create_function_transcribe_audio: create a function that transcribes an audio file using the configured STT provider and returns the transcript text
test_function_is_stt_enabled: test whether speech-to-text transcription is enabled in the STT configuration
run_function_transcribe_local: run local transcription of an audio file using the faster-whisper model with automatic model loading
build_function_transcribe_groq: build a transcription call using the Groq Whisper API with free tier support and auto model correction
run_function_transcribe_openai: run transcription of an audio file using the OpenAI Whisper API with config or managed gateway fallback
